sentences.en: In the morning, we saw the island from afar.
It was grey and had three hills.
The sailors began speaking in low voices.
The mood on the ship became heavy.

sentences.ar: سيلفر حكى عن الجزيرة كإنه بيعرفها.
sentences.en: Silver spoke about the island as though he knew it.

sentences.ar: وقال إنه اشتغل مع القبطان فلينت زمان.
sentences.en: And he said he had worked with Captain Flint long ago.
